page.overview:
Who is Theatrhythm Final Fantasy quotes?

In Theatrhythm Final Fantasy, there are several instances where the characters will quote (or paraphrase) lines, usually from their games of origin. Additionally, before each score the player attempts, the party will construct a four-part randomized sentence. There are 15 main menu quotes, 4 party menu quotes and 4 level-up quotes for each character.

Note that the sentences are randomized, i.e. fragments on the same row of this table do not automatically appear together. Note also that the sentence is constructed in reverse party order, with the party leader speaking last.
